original_title.why: The stored heading reads 'Slik blir KI Norge – samler krefter for ansvarlig og innovativ kunstig intelligens'; the record drops the lead-in 'Slik blir' (literally 'This is what KI Norge will be'). Defensible as the title of the initiative, but not verbatim.

summary_claims.claim: KI Norge is a national initiative under Digdir whose purpose is to make it easier for businesses to adopt AI in a safe, lawful and value-creating way. Literal: 'KI Norge is a national initiative under the Directorate for Digitalisation'.
Runs the national AI sandbox together with Datatilsynet and Nkom.

scope.note: An AI adoption and guidance body rather than a safety institute; the extractor's scope_note is adequate.

note: Press release of 12 Jun 2026 and the 11 Feb 2026 release are stored. Date, issuer, director and sandbox claims match. The English title is the extractor's rendering ('samler krefter' = 'joins forces'), which is accurate; english_version 'none found' is right.
